content.text: Good, these redirect (302) to the actual file — that's normal for archive.org downloads and works fine with `curl -L`. Now let me search Internet Archive for more classic Lake District texts to fill out the corpus.

input.command:
search() {
  q="$1"
  curl -s "https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php?q=$q&fl%5B%5D=identifier&fl%5B%5D=title&fl%5B%5D=creator&fl%5B%5D=year&rows=8&output=json" | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
for doc in d['response']['docs']:
    print(doc.get('identifier'),'|',doc.get('title'),'|',doc.get('creator'),'|',doc.get('year'))
"
}
echo "--- West Guide to the Lakes ---"; search "title%3A%28guide+to+the+lakes%29+AND+creator%3A%28West%29"
echo "--- Gilpin Observations Lakes ---"; search "title%3A%28Observations+lakes+Cumberland%29"
echo "--- Otley Lakes ---"; search "title%3A%28Concise+Description+English+Lakes%29"
